review_method: Fresh static read of all 49 canonical SKILL.md files in bounded batches, manifest/groups/routing/install guide and all seven declared references/assets/helper scripts. Runner payload identity inspected against root script; runner behavior is outside this ledger. No historical runtime PASS was reused.

findings.expected: Manifest currently contains 49 skills; ideally describe manifest-driven count to avoid repeated stale prose.
findings.verification: Fresh text read against parsed manifest; no runtime assertion.

findings.observed: Comparable baseline conditions are required but installed global/project skill and prior-history contamination are not named explicitly.
findings.verification: Static instruction inspection; no false effectiveness claim or runtime failure asserted.

findings.observed: Standalone leaf research workflows omit explicit source-snapshot/recheck and embedded-instruction treatment present in loop-research.
findings.verification: Static comparison only; host authority rules may independently protect users.

The compatibility entrypoint serves old/mixed requests and includes standalone fallback. No evidence justifies breaking it.

limits: All 49 classifications are static architecture/instruction judgments, not measured skill effectiveness.
Runtime validation and native discovery for this inventory pass are NOT_RUN. Refer to separately identified experiments for their narrower execution scope.
All helper/reference text was read; bundled runner source was identity checked only, not a fresh line-by-line semantic audit.
No recommendation alone is a confirmed bug. No new skill, split, merge or deprecation is justified by this inspection.

skills.reason: Prioritized source-backed findings remain distinct from planning, grading and adoption; installed delivery surfaces are explicitly included.
Small authorized implementation batches retain acceptance IDs, source identity, negative controls and installed-artifact verification.
Competing hypotheses and reproduction frequency preserve the distinction between investigation and repair.
Minimization preserves the failing observation and explicitly avoids an unsupported fix claim.
Repeated comparable measurements and variance are required before an improvement claim.
Known-good/failing revisions and rerun evidence define a distinct historical-isolation workflow.
Dated primary sources, exact revision/content identity, untrusted-source treatment and benchmark applicability are explicit.
Repository adoption criteria are useful, but the leaf workflow does not inherit the current general-research source-snapshot/recheck and embedded-instruction rules when installed alone.
Capability/permission/data-flow adoption review is useful, but standalone instructions omit the general-research exact source identity/recheck and explicit embedded-instruction rule.
Risk-based layer selection, frozen criteria, controlled failures and end-state checks are more useful than indiscriminate test volume.
Isolated function/module assertions and preservation of acceptance criteria remain a distinct focused route.
Boundary setup, cleanup and reproducibility are explicit; real service availability remains an execution prerequisite.
Line, branch, path and mutation evidence are separated and thresholds cannot be weakened for a green result.
Documentation claims are traced to source; command/link verification is scoped and unavailable checks remain visible.
Responsibility comparison, frozen realistic tasks, artifact checks, resource declaration and instruction-history invalidation cover authoring lifecycle.
Explicit host adapter, finite limits and terminal markers separate process continuation from native host compatibility; descendant cleanup limitation is disclosed.
Explicit invocation only, N+1 hard ceiling, early stops and retained state distinguish bounded follow-ups from unrestricted autonomy.
A demonstrated failing baseline precedes repair and rerun; failure to reproduce is not promoted to a verified fix.
Authorized assets, reachability, impact and safe local probes prevent a generic scan result becoming a security guarantee.
Observable behavior and characterization baseline distinguish restructuring from requested feature changes.
Run/job/revision identity and local versus remote results address a genuine pipeline-specific boundary.
Rebuild checksum comparison is required for reproducibility and install success is separated from build success.
Stable criteria, context identities and positive/negative controls are explicit; planning does not authorize implementation.
Manifest/lockfile consistency, advisory uncertainty and lifecycle-script authorization are explicit.
Dry-run, invariant preservation, idempotence and actually exercised rollback define persisted-state transformation.
Real entry point, invalid-input journey and absence of unwanted side effects distinguish E2E from unit mocks.
Frozen oracles, denominators, all-attempt retention and pass@k/pass^k are sound; comparable baseline guidance should explicitly name instruction/history/global-skill leakage.
Independent invariants, untouched baseline and failing regression before root repair support falsifiable false-PASS testing.
Per-cell real execution, unsupported controls and separation of synchronized bytes from host discovery constrain compatibility claims.
Versioned protocol/transport and tool trust boundaries prevent skill text being mistaken for a running server.
Offline envelope, live transport, authentication and host interoperability are separately labeled.
Tool annotations are hints rather than enforcement; synthetic credentials and absent forbidden side effects are explicit.
Known artifact, authorized environment, health gate and observed rollback remain distinct from release readiness.
Signal provenance, absent data versus zero, noise and actual alert delivery are explicit without implicit persistent monitoring.
Task-relevant source selection preserves critical constraints and distinguishes matching hashes from faithful summary meaning.
Resume rechecks source/artifact drift and retained failures; saved commands are not grants of authority.
Software MVP slices and actual user-visible gates remain separate from non-software work and narrow edits.
Base/head identity and exact remote-head CI follow publication; a local PASS is not review or merge authorization.
Operational impact, hypotheses, containment, observation windows and user-facing recovery are separate claims.
Consequential facts, unknown commitments and actual requested-file delivery are checked separately from sending.
Read coverage, source qualifiers, contradictions and material omissions constrain faithful compression.
Proposal, decision, ownership, due date and completion are independently supported rather than inferred from a transcript.
Existing compatibility selector has explicit file/work branches and a safe standalone fallback; deleting it would break established invocation.
Hard constraints, unknown feasibility, compatible units and sensitivity prevent fabricated precise recommendations.
Observable learning outcomes, time arithmetic and actual learner responses distinguish planning from demonstrated mastery.
Done criteria, actual deliverables, capacity and task-state/check-state separation cover office packages without imposing software planning.
Pinned regular-file inventory, separate native moves, protected identities and nontransactional concurrency limits define a bounded helper contract.
Explicit types/units/missing policy, exact arithmetic and formula/layout separation constrain table claims.
Requested format, reopened final artifact and distinct content/container/layout/export checks prevent file-extension-only acceptance.
